name: Electroactive Polymers & Artificial Muscles
summary: Covers soft actuator materials that mimic muscle, from dielectric elastomers to fibre muscles, and what limits their use in robots and wearable exoskeletons.

topics.name: Natural muscle as a benchmark: strain, stress, power density and efficiency
Dielectric elastomer actuators: Maxwell stress, electrodes and breakdown
Ionic polymer-metal composites and conducting-polymer actuators
Twisted and coiled polymer fibre muscles (nylon) and carbon-nanotube yarn muscles
Pneumatic and hydraulically amplified soft actuators (HASEL)
Durability, fatigue and control of soft actuators
Applications: soft robotics, prosthetics, haptics and wearable assistive suits
